title: Critical Constraint: HALEU Fuel Supply
description: High-Assay Low-Enriched Uranium (HALEU) is required by many advanced reactors (Oklo, X-energy, Kairos, microreactors). Centrus (LEU) operates the only currently licensed western commercial HALEU production facility at Piketon, OH — an important near-term bottleneck, not a permanent monopoly. Competing / complementary paths include BWXT downblending and fuel-cycle work, plus longer-dated Orano, Urenco and GLE (Silex/Cameco) capacity. Sep 2026: definitive multi-year HALEU agreements with Antares and Radiant (prepayments supporting expansion) and an about $500M Class A common + warrants raise. Do not cite expired June 2026 DOE contract wording as the live constraint narrative. Educational research only — not investment advice. No invented ratings.
